metaDescription: Order custom quarter zip backpacks in bulk. Perfect for corporate gifts, events, and employee swag. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Quarter zip backpacks combine the convenience of a backpack with the easy-access design of a jacket-style opening. Instead of fumbling with a traditional flap and buckle, users unzip the top panel to grab their laptop or lunch. This makes them ideal for commuters, trade show attendees, or employees who need quick access to their gear. The streamlined silhouette also offers a clean canvas for screen printing or embroidery, letting your logo stand out without clutter.
heroAltText: Custom quarter zip backpacks with embroidered logo, featuring easy-access top zipper and padded straps.
